title: Ascendance of a Bookworm ~I'll do anything to become a librarian!~ Part 2 I'll even join the temple to read books!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manga adaptation of Part 2 of the Ascendance of a Bookworm novels: Myne, a book-loving girl reborn into a medieval-style world, negotiates to become an apprentice blue shrine maiden at the temple so she can read in its book room and be treated like a noble (J-Novel Club blurb via AniList and MU). The temple's status-based structure and her difficult attendants make life hard (blurb); MU also lists orphanage, politics involving religion, business and family drama. Complete in 13 volumes; Myne is sickly (MU).
life_message: Love of books and learning, pursued with ingenuity and care for family and the poor, can change a rigid society.
